scope: Every returned WorldSense frame/query model call, first/warm/failure, once. Invalid integration control calls are retained separately and ineligible for speed. Native correctness calls remain raw JSON, not performance samples.
decode: (generated-1)/(total-TTFT), includes host/stop/possible extraEOS/IPC/snapshot costs, not pureGPU.
memory: Snapshots, not peaks/freeRAM/residency. Candidate controlled-process sums per category may double-count shared pages. Recommended device limit is not summed. LegacyWS10 missing memory stays unavailable, never zero. Per-process sample rows exist only for candidate gateway telemetry; RAW control process identity follows its cohort manifest.
parent_wall: One native Skill request row only; do not sum parent wall across model phases.
initialization: First request preserved separately; old ready API lacks separate worker/model-load decomposition. No hardware-cold claim.
confirmation: Resource/screen exports are not independent confirmation or proof of isolated mechanism causality.
